description: On the tabletop in front of you are a round white base with a threaded center and a cross-shaped white bench piece off to the right. The right hand moves in from the right to pick up the cross-shaped bench (right-hand object), brings it leftward over the round base, and lowers it onto the center post while the left hand hovers nearby to help align it; then both hands release, leaving the bench seated on the round table base.
